title: Product Rule
text: When two independent events must both occur, multiply their individual probabilities. For B_ from Bb x Bb: 3/4 show dominant phenotype.

title: Recessive Phenotype Probability
text: For ss from Ss x Ss: only 1/4 are homozygous recessive (ss). So black fur (3/4) AND long hair (1/4) = 3/4 x 1/4 = 3/16.
